newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-WAUGH RECALLED FOR ONE-DAY CLASH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WAUGH RECALLED FOR ONE-DAY CLASH.

text.p: Australia on Thursday recalled all-rounder Steve Waugh for the World Series limited overs match against Pakistan in Adelaide after he recovered from injury.
Waugh made an immediate return to the side and will replace fellow all-rounder Stuart Law at Adelaide Oval on Sunday in the third match of the triangular tournament.
Waugh injured his groin while bowling during the first test against West Indies in Brisbane in late November, forcing him to miss the second test in Sydney and two World Series matches.
Australia, who lead West Indies 2-0 in the five-match test series, won their opening two World Series fixtures against the same opponents last weekend.
Pakistan, who arrived in Australia on Wednesday, will play their first match on Sunday.

Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Ian Healy, Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath, Tom Moody, Ricky Ponting, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh (12th man to be named).
